CREATE TABLE "public"."app_settings" (
  "key" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "value" jsonb NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("key")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."audit_logs" (
  "action" text NOT NULL,
  "actorId" int4,
  "actorRole" text,
  "after" jsonb,
  "before" jsonb,
  "createdAt" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "entity" text NOT NULL,
  "entityId" text,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "ip" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."custodial_wallets" (
  "address" text NOT NULL,
  "bridgeWalletId" text NOT NULL,
  "chain" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "customerId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "custodial_wallets_chain_check_ed6bea37" CHECK ("chain" IN ('base', 'solana'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."customers" (
  "bridgeCustomerId" text,
  "country" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "endorsements" jsonb,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "kycLink" text,
  "kycLinkId" text,
  "kycStatus" text DEFAULT 'not_started' NOT NULL,
  "onboardedAt" timestamptz(3),
  "payoutWalletId" int4,
  "region" text,
  "rejectionReasons" jsonb,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'Onboarding' NOT NULL,
  "suspendedAt" timestamptz(3),
  "tosLink" text,
  "tosStatus" text DEFAULT 'pending' NOT NULL,
  "type" text,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "userId" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "customers_status_check_8bb956f2" CHECK ("status" IN ('Onboarding', 'Active', 'Suspended')),
  CONSTRAINT "customers_type_check_c5ba0656" CHECK ("type" IN ('individual', 'business'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."fee_schedules" (
  "cancelledAt" timestamptz(3),
  "createdAt" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "createdById" int4,
  "effectivePeriod" text NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "notes" text,
  "notifyCustomers" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "publishedAt" timestamptz(3),
  "publishedById" int4,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'Draft' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "fee_schedules_status_check_b068110f" CHECK ("status" IN ('Draft', 'Scheduled', 'Active', 'Superseded', 'Cancelled'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."fee_tiers" (
  "feeScheduleId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "fromInCents" int8 NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "position" int4 NOT NULL,
  "rateBps" int4 NOT NULL,
  "toInCents" int8,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."key_vault_canaries" (
  "authTag" bytea NOT NULL,
  "ciphertext" bytea NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "dataKeyAuthTag" bytea NOT NULL,
  "dataKeyIv" bytea NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "iv" bytea NOT NULL,
  "masterKeyVersion" text NOT NULL,
  "wrappedDataKey" bytea NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."monthly_volumes" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "customerId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "feeInCents" int8 DEFAULT '0'::int8 NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "periodKey" text NOT NULL,
  "txCount" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "version" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "volumeInCents" int8 DEFAULT '0'::int8 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."one_time_codes" (
  "attempts" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "codeHash" text NOT NULL,
  "consumedAt" timestamptz(3),
  "createdAt" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "expiresAt" timestamptz(3) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "meta" jsonb,
  "purpose" text NOT NULL,
  "userId" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "one_time_codes_purpose_check_4e1d9a7a" CHECK ("purpose" IN ('EmailVerify', 'PasswordReset', 'WalletKeyExport', 'WalletChange'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."support_messages" (
  "authorId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "body" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "isStaff" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "ticketId" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."support_tickets" (
  "assigneeId" int4,
  "createdAt" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "customerId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "lastMessageAt" timestamptz(3),
  "status" text DEFAULT 'Open' NOT NULL,
  "subject" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "support_tickets_status_check_f88e88ac" CHECK ("status" IN ('Open', 'Pending', 'Resolved', 'Closed'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."transaction_events" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "payload" jsonb,
  "source" text NOT NULL,
  "transactionId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "transaction_events_source_check_4cd88e2e" CHECK ("source" IN ('bridge_va', 'bridge_transfer', 'system', 'admin'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."transactions" (
  "attempts" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "bridgeDepositId" text NOT NULL,
  "bridgeTransferId" text,
  "completedAt" timestamptz(3),
  "createdAt" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "creditedAmountInCents" int8,
  "creditedAt" timestamptz(3),
  "currency" text NOT NULL,
  "customerId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "destinationWalletSnapshot" jsonb,
  "exchangeFeeInCents" int8,
  "failureReason" text,
  "feeBreakdown" jsonb,
  "feeInCents" int8,
  "feeScheduleId" int4,
  "fundsReceivedAt" timestamptz(3),
  "fxRate" text,
  "grossAmountInCents" int8 NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "netAmountInCents" int8,
  "nextRetryAt" timestamptz(3),
  "periodKey" text,
  "rail" text,
  "sourceDetails" jsonb,
  "state" text DEFAULT 'Received' NOT NULL,
  "txHash" text,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "usdEquivalentInCents" int8,
  "version" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "virtualAccountId" int4,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "transactions_currency_check_29bea278" CHECK ("currency" IN ('usd', 'eur')),
  CONSTRAINT "transactions_state_check_70e62d22" CHECK ("state" IN ('Received', 'Converting', 'Credited', 'PayoutPending', 'PayoutSubmitted', 'Completed', 'InReview', 'Refunded', 'PayoutFailed'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."users" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "deletedAt" timestamptz(3),
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "isEmailVerified" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "lastLoginAt" timestamptz(3),
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "password" text NOT NULL,
  "role" text DEFAULT 'Customer' NOT NULL,
  "totpEnabled" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "totpSecret" text,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "users_role_check_2e8c077e" CHECK ("role" IN ('Customer', 'Support', 'Admin'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."virtual_accounts" (
  "bridgeVirtualAccountId" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "custodialWalletId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "customerId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "deactivatedAt" timestamptz(3),
  "depositInstructions" jsonb NOT NULL,
  "destinationChain" text NOT NULL,
  "destinationCurrency" text NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "sourceCurrency" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "virtual_accounts_destinationChain_check_5d330b1a" CHECK ("destinationChain" IN ('base', 'solana')),
  CONSTRAINT "virtual_accounts_sourceCurrency_check_059d2431" CHECK ("sourceCurrency" IN ('usd', 'eur'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."wallet_keys" (
  "algorithm" text DEFAULT 'aes-256-gcm' NOT NULL,
  "authTag" bytea NOT NULL,
  "ciphertext" bytea NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "dataKeyAuthTag" bytea NOT NULL,
  "dataKeyIv" bytea NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "iv" bytea NOT NULL,
  "keyFormat" text NOT NULL,
  "masterKeyVersion" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "walletId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "wrappedDataKey" bytea NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."wallets" (
  "address" text NOT NULL,
  "chain" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "customerId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "keyExportedAt" timestamptz(3),
  "keyRemovedAt" timestamptz(3),
  "label" text,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'Active' NOT NULL,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "wallets_chain_check_ed6bea37" CHECK ("chain" IN ('base', 'solana')),
  CONSTRAINT "wallets_status_check_b8b0c336" CHECK ("status" IN ('Active', 'Archived')),
  CONSTRAINT "wallets_type_check_e1df0d92" CHECK ("type" IN ('Generated', 'External'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."webhook_events" (
  "attempts" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "bridgeEventId" text NOT NULL,
  "category" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "error" text,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "objectId" text,
  "payload" jsonb NOT NULL,
  "processedAt" timestamptz(3),
  "receivedAt" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'Pending' NOT NULL,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "webhook_events_status_check_9ebe27a1" CHECK ("status" IN ('Pending', 'Processed', 'Failed', 'Ignored'))
)
